text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tackling the Takarazuka Kinen with a 
renewed mindset, Matikanefukukitaru 
achieved a miraculous comeback victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Determined to keep dashing forward at this 
momentum through the summer, 
Matikanefukukitaru renews her resolve.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, she announced that she would 
decide on her next race just like she 
always did—by drawing a fortune slip.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Not to rely on luck, but to overcome any 
hardship on her own two legs.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Target race changed to Hakodate Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The result is the Hakodate Kinen! 
Matikanefukukitaru dashed off toward the 
land of the million-dollar night view!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Target race changed to Kokura Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The result is the Kokura Kinen! 
Matikanefukukitaru dashed off toward the 
fiery battle in Kyushu, home of the fire 
gods!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Target race changed to Sapporo Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The result is the Sapporo Kinen! She 
pumped herself up to win this midsummer 
race and host a "Fortune Festival" instead 
of a Snow Festival.
